{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Bias correction: If sentiment is positive (≥0.00) and forecast is consistently below true outcome, increase forecast by 1-2% of recent 7-day average.",
    "Lag correction: If true outcome is higher than forecast by >5% and sentiment is neutral or positive, adjust forecast upward by 1-3% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "Overshoot correction: After a spike in price (true > forecast by >10%), reduce forecast by 2-5% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "Mean reversion: If forecast is significantly above true outcome (by >10%) and sentiment is negative, apply downward adjustment proportional
